subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
lesson: Unit 3 – Lesson 7: Review and Get ready for Starters
outcomes: I can listen and write body words.
I can read instructions and match them to pictures.
I can read sentences about a picture and say Yes or No.

tf.why: It tells you what to do.

tf.s: "I've got six legs" can describe a silly monster.
tf.why: A monster can have six legs.

tf.s: A robot with two legs matches "I've got three legs."
tf.why: Two legs do not match three legs, so No.

tf.s: A green face matches "I've got a green face."
"Point to the purple robot" means show the purple robot with your finger.
tf.why: Point means show with your finger.

tf.s: "Put the pink pencil on the purple robot" means put the pencil under the robot.
tf.why: "On" means on top of the robot.

tf.s: "Move your arms" is about your feet.
"I've got eight fingers" tells us a number and a body part.
tf.why: Eight is the number; fingers is the body part.

tf.s: We say "I've got three heads" for a monster with three heads.

boxes.why: Touch your head means hand on head.

mcq.q: Which word is a body part?
In the Starters task, what do we write?
mcq.why: We read and write Yes or No.

mcq.q: Which colour is in the Starters task?
Read: I've got eight fingers. The robot has got eight fingers. Write:
The examiner says: Put the pink pencil on the purple robot. Where is the pencil now?

o: I've got three heads and six legs.

mcq.q: A robot has got a blue tummy. Read: I've got a yellow tummy. What do you write?
mcq.why: Blue is not yellow, so No.

mcq.q: Why do we check every detail in the picture?
o: To be sure the sentence matches.
mcq.why: Every word must match the picture.

mcq.q: Which instruction is like the examiner's?
mcq.why: The examiner gives Point to ... and Put the ... on ....
